uiConfig.name: Service Principal
uiConfig.description: Authenticate Microsoft Fabric Warehouse and OneLake using a Microsoft Entra service principal

fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.note: Create a Microsoft Entra service principal and enable the Fabric/Power BI tenant setting that allows service principals to use Fabric APIs.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.note: Grant the service principal Contributor or higher on both the source Lakehouse workspace and the target Warehouse workspace.
